io.writer

Class WriteWorkbookStreaming

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.writer.AbstractWorkbook
      • io.writer.WriteWorkbookStreaming
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelWritable, Writable, java.lang.AutoCloseable

    public class WriteWorkbookStreaming
extends AbstractWorkbook
    Streaming Excel workbook writer extending AbstractWorkbook using Apache POI's SXSSFWorkbook.

    SXSSFWorkbook is an API-compatible streaming extension of XSSF used when very large spreadsheets must be produced with limited heap space. Low memory consumption is achieved by retaining a sliding window of active rows in memory while flushing older rows to temporary files on disk.

    Change log:

    • 26 October 2021 - Initial implementation.
    • 6 October 2026 - Updated resource cleanup, NIO output streams, and open-time extension checks.

    26 October 2021

      • WriteWorkbookStreaming

        public WriteWorkbookStreaming(java.lang.String file,
                              java.lang.String tabName,
                              boolean useSharedStringsTable)
                       throws TabularDataException
        Instantiates a new streaming Excel workbook with options for enabling the shared strings table.

        Note: Enabling the shared strings table may reduce resultant file size, but requires Apache POI to keep all distinct string literals in memory during processing. For extremely large datasets, keeping this option false is recommended to prevent high heap usage or OutOfMemoryError.

        Parameters:
        file - the relative or absolute path to the target XLSX file
        tabName - the name of the initial worksheet tab to create
        useSharedStringsTable - true to enable the shared strings table; false to write strings inline
        Throws:
        TabularDataException - if the specified file path cannot be resolved
